description_en: Calls CreateKeyPair to create an SSH key pair. The system stores the public key and returns the private key in unencrypted PEM-encoded PKCS#8 format. You must securely store the private key on your own
description_zh: 调用CreateKeyPair创建一对SSH密钥对。系统会为您保管密钥的公钥部分，并返回未加密的PEM编码的PKCS#8格式私钥。您需要自行妥善保管私钥部分
kebab_example: aliyun ecs create-key-pair --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-key-pair-name testKeyPairName --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateKeyPair

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the key pair. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对所在的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the key pair. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the SSH key pair belongs
parameters.help_zh: SSH密钥对所在的企业资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The tag key of the key pair. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 密钥对的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the key pair. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 密钥对的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: value

KeyPairFingerPrint.description_en: The fingerprint of the key pair. The fingerprint uses the MD5 message-digest algorithm based on the public key fingerprint format defined in RFC 4716. For more information, see RFC4716 (https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4716)
KeyPairFingerPrint.description_zh: 密钥对的指纹。根据RFC4716定义的公钥指纹格式，采用MD5信息摘要算法。更多信息，请参见RFC4716 (https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4716)。

KeyPairId.description_en: The ID of the SSH key pair

KeyPairName.description_en: The name of the key pair

PrivateKeyBody.description_en: The private key of the key pair. The private key is PEM-encoded in PKCS#8 format
PrivateKeyBody.description_zh: 密钥对的私钥。PEM编码的PKCS#8格式的私钥部分
